name: Limitless Nexus
description: Clean Limitless provider branch built one source at a time for maintainable anime, animation, drama, movie, and TV coverage.

scrapers.name: Re:ANIME
scrapers.description: Anime provider using TMDB/IMDb to MAL/AniList identity mapping and Re:ANIME's structured Flix API. DUB prefers direct MKV. SUB now follows AniYomi's proven approach: decode and parse the FlixCloud master during scraping, expose concrete quality child playlists to Nuvio, then use the shared Limitless FlixCloud proxy only for child-playlist rewriting and media-segment decoding.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus port based on maintained Re:ANIME, AniYomi playlist parsing, and FlixCloud reference implementations
